basic_profile.bio: I'm Alex, a 27-year-old software engineer from Columbus, Ohio. My work involves coding and developing applications, which gives me a great excuse to be online often. I've been into biking since college, and I enjoy exploring the trails and roads around my city. I'm a huge fan of Beşiktaş, and I love discussing sports, especially soccer, with fellow fans. In my free time, I dabble in tabletop RPGs and am slowly learning to be a Dungeon Master. I'm single, and my late-night coding sessions often extend into the early hours, which is when I'm most active on Reddit.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in biking comes from years of personal experience and a lot of trial and error. I started with mountain biking but have recently been focusing more on road and gravel biking. Additionally, my technical expertise comes from a computer science degree and several years of working in the tech industry.
